name: Steady hover
description: Find hover throttle and stay inside a target without drifting.

steps.text: Use Angle mode for this exercise. Throttle controls lift; small roll and pitch corrections stop drift.
steps.title: Understand lift and Angle mode

steps.text: Take off and hold inside the marker for four seconds. Stay below 1 m/s; passing through it quickly does not count.
steps.title: Hold a steady hover

steps.text: Return to the start marker. Level the drone, lower throttle gently and hold a stopped landing for two seconds.
steps.title: Land at the start
